rules.violated_clause: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) must be clearly declared on the package under Legal Metrology Rules.
Net quantity of the commodity contained in the package must be declared under Legal Metrology Rules.
Name of the manufacturer must be declared on the package.
Complete address of the manufacturer must be declared on the package.
Country of origin of the product must be specified for consumer awareness.
Consumer care details (email and/or phone) must be provided.
Month and year of manufacture or import must be declared on the package.
Name and address of the importer must be declared for imported commodities.
